title: Guided tutor verified: 317 tests and web export passed
summary: Verified response-gated teaching, persisted feedback/review cards, privacy controls, retry, restart and progressive hints. Existing server tutor boundary retained; live provider teaching quality remains unverified.

changes.detail: Guided diagnosis, one concept, teach-back, mini challenge, mastery check and recap with persisted learner response gates and AI feedback provenance.
Server instructions adapt to depth, confidence and errors; optional cross-course context sharing; no credentials or provider calls added to the client.
Quiz hints reveal one step at a time; quiz and exam results schedule deduplicated Memory Studio cards; deleting tutor records removes corresponding review cards.

Regression check caught stale embedded server prompt source. Refreshed the source library with the repository generator; no regression assertions removed. Fixed an encoded ellipsis in the new interaction-test fixture.
Audit and implementation notes describe retained integrations, AI feedback provenance, privacy scope, scheduling and untested deployment boundaries.

validation.name: Focused tutor checks
validation.detail: 22 tests passed: actual React tutor journey with controlled provider fixtures, gradual hints, scheduler linkage, exam submission, migration, malformed state, privacy deletion and existing server auth/stream/error contracts.

validation.name: Full regression suite
validation.detail: 317 tests passed, zero failures after source refresh. Initial run had 316 pass and one stale-source failure. Logs: artifacts/tutor-guided-tests.log and artifacts/tutor-guided-tests-verified.log.

validation.name: Type checks

validation.name: Live validation limits
validation.detail: No paid live provider call, real-device run, authenticated browser visual preview, database migration or deployment. Full automated journey uses controlled AI fixtures, not fabricated live responses.
